Specialization.Name: Ambassador (reSpecialized) 1.01
Specialization.Description: [H4]Ambassador (reSpecialized)[h4] [B]AMBASSADOR—PITHY DESCRIPTION[b][BR] [B]At a Glance[b][BR] The ambassador is the “all positive, classic diplomat" character. They are charming, shrewd, and knowledgeable. Also skillful orators, the ambassador uses the motivations of would-be allies to win them to their cause[BR] [B]All-in or Hybrid?[b][BR] ⅓ General Charm (and Leadership) ⅓ Negotiation ⅙ Social Defense ⅙ Charm as a Tool [BR] [B]What Should it be the Best At?[b][BR] Making and using friends for the greater good of their government[BR] Being Charming[BR] [B]What should it be just “good” at?[b][BR] Leadership[BR] Being hard to Rattle[BR] Negotiation[BR] [B]Specs for Comparison / Inspiration[b][BR] [I]Republic Representative[i](The Rep-Rep is more a pure negotiator, much more like the Arbiter in that sense. Ambassador has to be an equal opportunity schmoozer)[BR] [I]Senator[i](Senator is structured much more like Politico, playing into Deception and Negotiation than a pure charming character. It dipping its toe into leadership and mass combat is more of a nod to the Senator’s role.). [I]Arbiter[i](Pure Negotiation. With some odd enforcer abilities. The big difference is that of a mediator vs an interested party). [I]Charmer[i](Probably the closest in overall social structure, using all the tools of Presence to win friends and allies). [B]Media Touchstones[b][BR] Leia Organa (Star Wars: Rebels)[BR] Bail Organa (Star Wars: Rebels)[BR] Padme Amidala (Star Wars: Clone Wars)[BR] Londo Mollari (Babylon 5)[BR] Delenn (Babylon 5)[BR] [I]updated 12/10/2025[i]
